tasks.label: Build Descent SlikeNet
args: export PATH=/c/Programs/msys64/mingw64/bin:$PATH; cmake -G Ninja -B build; status=$?; if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then exit $status; fi; cmake --build build -- -j10; status=$?; if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then exit $status; fi; if [ -f build/main/d1x-redux.exe ]; then mkdir -p /c/Games/D1x /c/Games/D1x2; cp -v build/main/d1x-redux.exe /c/Games/D1x/D1x-Redux-SLikeNet.exe; cp -v build/main/d1x-redux.exe /c/Games/D1x2/D1x-Redux-SLikeNet.exe; else echo Build completed, but no expected executable was found. >&2; exit 1; fi

tasks.label: Reconfigure D1s CMake
args: del /q C:\Games\D1s\build\CMakeCache.txt && rmdir /s /q C:\Games\D1s\build\CMakeFiles && C:\Programs\msys64\mingw64\bin\cmake.exe -G Ninja -S C:\Games\D1s -B C:\Games\D1s\build
